t.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>的前提是 ?A → (?A → ?B)：?A 出现两次，两处必须是同一句。拆开后有两个关于 ?A 的等式。新元件「消元」：找到 ?A ≐ t，把其余等式里的 ?A 都换成 t。
t.en: <part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>’s premise is ?A → (?A → ?B): ?A occurs twice, and both places must be the same sentence. Split, it gives two equations about ?A. A new part, “Eliminate”, finds ?A ≐ t and puts t for ?A in the other equations.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：把每组等式解到底；对不上的，说「失败」。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that solves each set of equations to the end, or says “failed” when they do not fit.

hint.zh: ?A 确定以后，把别处的 ?A 也换掉，再看剩下的是否对得上。
hint.en: Once ?A is known, replace it everywhere else, and see whether the rest fits.
